prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: reusable transparent-background hero illustration for the Ferramenta Rust-engine family.
Primary request: ONE delicate precision flexure bridge assembly, a beautifully machined thin satin stainless steel arched bridge between two very small cylindrical anchor posts. A narrow warm stabilized iron-oxide inlay is recessed into the bridge. Exactly two tiny flush countersunk Torx screws at the anchors. Instrument-grade metal, fine chamfers, subtle natural machining marks, clean soft silver reflections, sophisticated fine mechanics, carefully made and durable. Very thin cross sections, not thick or heavy. Slightly elevated three-quarter front perspective, entire assembly centered and fully visible with generous transparent padding, no crop. Soft neutral studio light, no cast background shadow. Genuine transparent alpha background; no white surface or checkerboard baked into image. No wood, gears, machines, tools, pipework, dirt, grunge, loose parts, text, logo, type, watermark or frame. This is one reusable cutout object, not a website mockup.
